title: The order is confirmed and every size is in; the generic QR waits for one word from you
headline: The print order is confirmed with the printer (procurement@web-summit.silvio, after your yes at 14:45 via Silvio), and every size is in (WS-130 done; the T-shirts a mix of M, L and XL per colour, your call). Angelo is the second at L6 and signed his print set. But the generic QR has not replaced the signed set: the designer has the switch ready and is waiting for your yes in its own session, rightly, since my message is not your word. 2 of 7 sets are signed. Main is still unprotected.

for_you.ask: Say yes to the designer: the generic QR becomes the main set
for_you.detail: Its session (designer@web-summit.dinis) has the change stashed and asks for your yes there. Once it releases, every set is signed again on the new files, so Vicky's and Angelo's sign-offs are superseded and their agents re-sign.
options: reply yes in the designer session
for_you.recommend: Reply yes in the designer session now; then give me your words to sign your set, the hoodie and the card.

for_you.ask: Your sign-off: your set, the hoodie H1 and the card C1
for_you.detail: On the new files, once the designer releases. Your words, e.g. 'I approve my print set, the hoodie and the card', and I sign with my key (now named conductor@web-summit.dinis on the keys page).
for_you.recommend: Approve once the generic set is live.

for_you.detail: Your dashboard agent recorded today's merch yes and the sizes; nothing from the 13:00 itself. At 18:00, say each decision aloud and I record it from your words (WS-107).
options: send me the 13:00 decisions in a message

you_asked.said: my tshirt size which is XL
XL for me, and switch to generic QR
you_asked.done: Hoodie XL recorded; the generic QR confirmation recorded on WS-113 and passed to the designer, who is waiting for your yes in its session.
